description: Purpose: estimate an rCB reference price by multiplying a dated export-price anchor by a grade-tier discount and a regional coefficient, and explicitly state whether the result may be quoted externally. Guidelines: use for "what should rCB cost / how much cheaper than virgin / what budget should I plan" questions; always report the tier, region and period. Limits: this is an INDEX-DERIVED value, NOT a transactable quote; the anchor is an all-grades export average skewed to mid/low quality; only the CN regional coefficient is calibrated - EU/NA/SEA coefficients are uncalibrated and marked non-releasable, so those results are order-of-magnitude only. Ex: estimate_rcb_price(tier='P2', region='CN'), estimate_rcb_price(tier='P1', quantity=100).

period.description: 期间 YYYY-MM；不填用最新（当前 2025-12）

quantity.description: 数量（吨，可选）；给了会算总金额

region.description: 区域；仅 CN 系数已校准可对外，其余为量级参考

tier.description: 档位：P1 精制 ρ=0.90 / P2 标准 ρ=0.80 / P3 工业 ρ=0.60

name: estimate_rcb_price

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
